programme.desc: An expectant couple heads to a remote cabin to have a natural childbirth, but comes under attack from a predatory midwife who will stop at nothing to snatch their unborn child from them.

programme.title: Cougar
programme.desc: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it’s too late.

programme.title: Back and Forth
programme.desc: Pier and Jade found love though the emotions of skating. Love was built but trust was lost, as deep secrets unfold, back and forth between the UK and USA. Having her heart broken, Jade took her fate in her own hands. It was only a matter of time, that the only plan left was to take revenge.

programme.title: How Did We Get Here
programme.desc: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity, Omar and Sonya struggle with commitment, Chastity and Monae have differing opinions on parenthood, and Stephanie and Delvin are struggling with their intimacy. As the couples dive into their treatment, they must confront their own demons to move forward. Will they make it out together? Or go their separate ways?

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: The Forsaken
programme.desc: After discovering an old book, Alex becomes drawn into the harrowing stories of cowboys Latt and Stylz. As he reads about their treasure hunt and daring adventures, Alex finds inspiration in their courage and friendship to use in his own life and help him find the strength to overcome his own obstacles.

programme.title: Transcend
programme.desc: Maranda spent her life looking for a protector, only to find herself lost in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal. From the wreckage of abandonment to a life-altering crossroads, her survival isn't just about escaping the past, it’s about surviving herself.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: The Loyalty Test
programme.desc: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star that has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, successfully turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Camera Girl
programme.desc: After witnessing Atlanta’s underground rap scene firsthand, a quiet but driven young woman buys her first camera and sets out to become a music videographer. But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programme.title: The Sermon
programme.desc: When a charismatic pastor’s sermons begin to influence a group of men searching for purpose, their actions evolve into a series of calculated crimes carried out in the name of righteousness.

programme.title: Why Not You
programme.desc: Young executive Quincy Jackson finds himself at odds with his current girlfriend, when he discovers his coworker Joi is in a similar situation of her own. As they bond over their relationship troubles, their fates become intertwined.

programme.title: Teacher's Pet
programme.desc: A young and charming student enters a new school, but he has a way to get what he wants, including manipulating his teacher. When she tries to end their inappropriate relationship, people start to die around her. Will she make it out of this relationship alive?

programme.title: Off Our Needles

programme.title: Artist's Academy
programme.desc: Welcome to Artists's Academy where we are dedicated to making you a better artist. We believe everyone has an artist within, waiting to be unleashed. Our mission is to be your ultimate resource for visual art education using tutorials covering everything from fundamental techniques to advanced concepts in painting and drawing.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Artists see things differently. Our first featured bead type is pierced metal. Then artist Kate Richbourg creates Frida Kahlo inspired ear wires that feature the motifs in her paintings. Next artist Brenda Schweder encases found objects in a Joseph Cornell inspired piece that shows off his iconic style. Tammy Honaman ends the episode with the first of a series of projects highlighting artists' favorite materials. She begins with the art of the chenille stitch and how changing the color and finish changes the design.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Energize your creativity by adding power. Cheryl Boglioli gets into the groove with a cool stenciling tool. May Flaum adds texture with sewing machine stitches. Cheryl Boglioli shares a painting tip. Joe Rotella lights up lettering with twinkling lights.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: You don't' necessarily need new materials to have a fresh look, maybe its taking something you are familiar with and using it in a new way. Joe Rotella begins with art toys made with a little engineering. Then, it's a shadow box abstract with Cat Kerr. Finally, encaustic wood tiles are a new way to look at using encaustic techniques with Mary Hettmansperger.

programme.title: Color Block Drunkard's Path Quilt

programme.desc: We all need those little aids to keep our life organized. Keep track of your notes, appts and dates with a handy note holder from Reen Wilcoxson. programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: Learn the details that will make your wardrobe a classic. There are little details that make a garment stand the test of time and they usually involve some sort of detail from the couture world. They are not necessarily difficult or time consuming -- but they show you took that extra step to make your garment a classic. Amy Alan demonstrates serging -- one of those techniques that is always classic. Then, we have another lesson of the Little Black Dress with Angela Wolf and how to use the lining as your facing. Finally, couture expert Susan Khalje has some special finish details for a professional look.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Once in a blue moon, as the legend goes, a baby Smurf is delivered to the Smurfs and everyone in the village becomes attached to the new arrival. But a mistake has been made and the stork returns to take the baby back. Grouchy and Smurfette have become so attached to the baby that the baby is returned.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Bigmouth steals the Smurfs' winter food supply and Brainy concocts one of Papa Smurf's magic strength potions so he can fight the greedy giant. The super formula wears off, but Papa Smurf works a fast switch, replacing the food with rocks and Bigmouth is none the wiser.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha turns herself into a Smurf, plotting revenge on the little people for destroying her magic locket. Papa Smurf outwits her and banishes her from the forest once more.

programme.title: The Baby Smurf
programme.desc: Gargamel turns himself into a Baby Smurf, to be adopted by the Smurfette. He causes complete chaos in the Smurf Village when he tries to blow it up with a time bomb! Papa Smurf discovers his evil plot and uses the explosive to send the wizard back to his dismal castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs' winter food supply is destroyed and they journey to a distant castle in search of shelter. Initially, they think the castle is haunted, but after they solve the mystery of a greedy pack of rats, the grateful owner presents them with an abundance of food for their long winter.

programme.title: The Purple Smurfs
programme.desc: The purple fly bites Lazy and an epidemic starts that turns the little villagers into angry, purple Smurfs. Papa Smurf discovers that the pollen from a tuberose flower is an antidote and soon things are smurfy again.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy makes an enlarging potion that turns Hefty into human size. The big-little strong man captures Gargamel and brings him back to the Smurf Village where Papa Smurf magically causes Azrael to chase his master back to his dreary castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The underground trolls who want them to be their slaves capture the Smurfs. Papa Smurf ingeniously frees them and then destroys the trolls' magic crystal ball that gives them power over the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In an effort to find out where the Smurfs' secret diamond stash is hidden, Gargamel pretends to be their friend. When he shows his true, wicked self, Papa Smurf works a magic spell to save his little Smurfs from the vicious clutches of the evil wizard.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Lazy dreams he is on Paradise Island and free from all the work Papa Smurf inflicts on him. His fantasy turns into a nightmare that sends him eagerly back to work once more.

programme.title: The Abominable Snowbeast
programme.desc: Brainy and his friends organize a journey to Ice Mountain to pick the rare snow flower for Papa Smurf. They meet a terrifying snow beast that befriends them, due to Smurfette's kindness, and helps them find the tiny flower.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette has found a new friend, Laura, a six-year-old child whose parents live near the forest. Together, the two girls wander in the forest. But an old witch who lives in the forest catches them.

programme.title: Gormandizing Greedy
programme.desc: Greedy overdoes it. He's getting heavier and heavier until his weight puts him in jeopardy. The evil Gargamel is going to catch him... Can Greedy be saved by Papa Smurf?

programme.title: Head Over Hogatha
programme.desc: Valentine's Day. Hogatha, the witch, is at the pond picking spore rot when, by accident, one of Cupid's arrows hits her. Now she is going to fall madly in love with the first man she sees... And as luck would have it, that man is Gargamel himself. Will he succeed in having her catch all the Smurfs in one fell swoop and will Hogatha get out of her fell swoop?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Gallant Smurf
programme.desc: Queen Felicity will not let her son, Prince Godfrey, marry his sweetheart Pricilla. What she wants as a daughter-in-law is a girl who shows her something she's never seen before. When Hogatha learns of this, and also discovers the existence of Grandpa Smurf, she feels confident that she can surprise the Queen with her capture. Of course, Hogatha must first capture Grandpa Smurf...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf's had enough. The Smurflings and Sassette keep on telling tales about him with unpleasant results. He therefore concocts a magic formula, taken from Papa Smurf's books of spells, which makes the little Smurfs' tails grow longer and longer every time they tell tales. What he hasn't counted on is that Gargamel now has a way of catching the Smurflings.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When the emergency call rings, all the Smurfs in the Village drop what they are doing and run to hear the news. But when Vanity Smurf calls for an assembly so that the Smurfs can admire his new hat, it is too much. They send him on his way out of the village, and Vanity has the bad luck of meeting Lofty, the Elf, who suggests a horrible mud bath...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What is that strange talking frog that Morlock the Wizard sends all of Prince Theodore's soldiers to catch? Is it a demon frog, as he says, or something else? Truth will out when Smurfette and the Smurflings meet the frog. They help to change this frog back into Prince Theodore himself, for he's been the victim of a spell cast by Morlock.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Every 500 years, Castle Captor appears and abducts innocent travelers. Grandpa takes off in his balloon for the castle, where he meets Nanny Smurf, who’s been missing for 500 years. They have only a short time to escape, or they’ll become permanent guests!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hefty, Handy, and Brainy lose Papa's telescope and Scour, the Lord of Lost and Found, finds it. The Smurfs say they'll trade anything to get it back, so Scour takes their most valuable possessions – handiness, heftiness and braininess. They journey to his domain to retrieve what was lost.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil warlock Nemesis shows up at the Wizards' Library to steal the knowledge from the Archives of Evil and so get the Long Life Stone. But it's Brainy who inadvertently saves the day when he switches Greedy's cookbook and Papa's spell book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Roommates Smurfette and Nanny are getting on each other's nerves, so the time has come for Nanny to have a house of her own. As Nanny and Smurfette trek off to find a house-warming plant, the others design the Smurfliest house for her.

programme.title: Can't Smurf The Music
programme.desc: There is nothing the sorceress Chlorhydris hates so much as love in the world. She would like to see all love banished from the face of the Earth, and she's going to start with music. She puts a spell on a magic horn so that it will suck the music out of every song... especially the Smurfs' songs. Helped by their friend Laconia, the Smurfs may be able to resist Chlorhydris' evil plan...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel has got hold of magical ectoplasmic crystal eggs that will enable him to change bodies with Papa Smurf. What better plan could there be? Disguised as Papa Smurf, he's going to lead all the Smurfs to his cauldron! But as fate would have it, Gargamel is changed into Puppy, the Smurf doggie...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's not every day you meet a talking flower. Especially not a character like Petaluma, a somewhat haughty bulb flower who Smurfette meets in the forest. Of course the delighted Smurfette takes Petaluma to the Village of the Smurfs... and starts a process that is going to endanger all of the Smurfs. Flowers, it seems, ought to be seen and not heard.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Everybody can make a mistake. Take Papa Smurf, for instance. His new perfume-enhancing spray makes a rose smell like a thousand roses...but due to a whole series of misadventures it also makes all the Smurfs cry, moved to tears by the slightest of pretexts. While they sob, bawl, wail moan and whimper, the evil wizard Gargamel does not stand still...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Tonight is talent show night in the Village of the Smurfs. Grandpa Smurf is going to do magic tricks, Sassette is going to perform with her trained pet frog, Clumsy is going to try his hand at juggling... and Jokey Smurf has made a dummy of Gargamel that he is sure will frighten the Smurfs out of their wits. But the real Gargamel finds a way to animate Jokey's dummy and then...

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Baby Smurf has lost all interest in toys. Even Jokey's surprises fail to amuse the tiny tyke. Grandpa Smurf suggests they go and pay a visit to the Toymaker, the one who makes toys for children all over the world. Or rather used to make: the Toymaker is tired of the lack of appreciation his toys receive from those who receive them.

programme.title: Handy's Window-Vision
programme.desc: Miner Smurf leaves no stone unturned and this is how he discovers a crystal that transmits images. Thus Handy is able to invent window-vision and, every morning from then on, the Smurfs are able to watch Hefty's workouts, Farmer Smurf's crop reports or even the Brainy Smurf Hour. But would you believe it? The evil wizard Gargamel takes advantage of this image-watching to catch Smurfs!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf has been elected Wizard of the Year, and the evil wizard Gargamel is beside himself with jealousy. He will see to it that Papa's powers all disappear. And then, he is sure to catch all the Smurfs and celebrate with a big feast... But now, would Papa Smurf let such a bad thing happen? Surely not, Papa finds a way to foil Gargamel's plan...

programme.title: The Colour Smurf
programme.desc: Spectra is the Colour Fairy, the one whose wheel of colours make all the blues, reds, yellows and greens of the world. She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sweepy the chimney sweep Smurf is not the most popular inhabitant of the Village of the Smurfs. He is rather messy, and the clouds of soot that he makes certainly don't add to his popularity. Only the Smurflings find him great company as he's the only one who can get dirty and not be told off. Yet in their enthusiasm for Sweepy, the Smurflings endanger the Village.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy learns it’s better to have smurfed than not to have smurfed at all when he learns his true love is really a mermaid. Can they really live with each other forever?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs busily build a time capsule for all of their talents, Papa Smurf frantically tries to unravel an ancient Druid riddle before disaster strikes the forest.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wicked wizard Gargamel asks the sorcerer Balthazar for a recipe to capture the Smurfs. It involves kidnapping Mother Nature to stop the arrival of Spring. Luckily, the Smurfs save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover the spirit and joy of friendly competition when they hold their first "Smurfic Games". After a near miss with the troublesome cat Azrael, the Smurfs decide they need to get into better shape. Papa Smurf suggests that the Smurfs tone their bodies as well as sharpen their athletic abilities by inaugurating the "Smurfic Games".

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy Smurf's misadventures take him across a river into Pussywillow Hollow. There he meets the Pixies – charming and shapely beings whose enemies, the Wartmongers, will meet the Smurfs in some unforeseen ways.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Growing, harvesting and preparing food takes up much of the Smurfs' time. Handy invents a machine that farms and processes food. But this wonderful invention has its drawbacks...

programme.title: S-Shivering S-Smurfs
programme.desc: Winter has come all of a sudden. The Smurfs are almost all victims of smurfmonia. Can Tracker Smurf find the healing smurfroot without falling into the evil Gargamel's traps?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is the dramatic, moving story of the friendship between Smurfette and her pet mouse. A sad event reduces Smurfette to tears... Can the Smurfs comfort the despairing Smurfette?

programme.title: It Came From Outer Smurf
programme.desc: Dreamy wants to encounter beings from outer space so much that no one believes him when he talks of having met one. Yet the arrival of this extraterrestrial is going to wreak havoc in the Smurf Village...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf has saved Clumsy from a horrible fate. Clumsy swears eternal devotion to his savior and does his best to repay his debt… With awkward results. A clever scheme is needed to stop Clumsy's well-meant catastrophes...

programme.title: Revenge Of The Smurfs
programme.desc: A war is raging in the Middle Ages. Knights in armor in hot pursuit inadvertently destroy the Smurfs Village so a small band of Smurfs decide to avenge this wrongdoing. Won't Papa Smurf think this is too human-like a reaction?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel has found a new diabolical scheme to get rid of the Smurfs: a glittering powder that is going to reduce them to helpless laughter...

programme.title: The A-Maze-Ing Smurfs
programme.desc: Jokey Smurf is dying to meet Melchior the Magnificent, creator of the famous Vanishing Box trick. Can Gargamel catch the Smurfs in Melchior's Amazing Maze?

programme.title: Smurf Van Winkle
programme.desc: Lazy Smurf is getting too lazy. The other Smurfs decide to play a trick on him: when he wakes up, he is surrounded by wrinkled, elderly Smurfs who tell him he has been sleeping for several centuries...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Scaredy Smurf runs into the Village screaming about the sky being about to smurf down. And just at the same moment, Papa Smurf is beset by uncontrollable fits of sneezing...

programme.title: Turncoat Smurf
programme.desc: Would you believe Brainy Smurf is the one who led the evil Gargamel to the Village of the Smurf? Of course he did not. But the others suspect him...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What a strange stone Clumsy has unearthed! In it, he can see events that are going to happen... Yet knowing part of the future sometimes brings bad luck!

programme.title: Heart Of Gold
programme.desc: Whatever Brainy Smurf says, the Clockwork Smurf devised by Handy has feelings just like any normal blue Smurf. At least it seems to be so until Clockwork Smurf loses what Handy had fitted inside its ribcage: a heart of gold. When the evil wizard Gargamel and his apprentice Scruple find the tiny contraption and fit it with a heart of stone, the Smurfs are in for a bad time...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: The Village Vandal
programme.desc: Nasty wizard Gargamel has had enough of the Smurfs' permanent superiority. He decides to destroy their Village once and for all. This is why he trains a termite to ravage, demolish, devastate and raze all the houses in its path. But the effect is even worse than Gargamel imagined as the Smurfs think that their Village is being torn apart by the antics of the Smurflings.

programme.title: Master Scruple
programme.desc: Farmer Smurf is the reluctant master of a genie named Gourdy, whose enthusiasm for service is somewhat excessive. After yet another incident due to Gourdy's overzealousness, Farmer Smurf says something he shouldn't and Gourdy disappears. And guess who finds him? Well, it's Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel. And who should steal Gourdy from Scruple, if not Gargamel himself?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: An evil imp gives Smurfette dancing shoes and then tricks her into promising to marry him. All her little friends rush to her rescue and Papa Smurf magically puts the dancing shoes on the imp. He is forced to dance off into the night.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sir Hefty discovers a wayward knight to help him defeat a dragon whose fire is threatening to destroy the forest. Alas, the knight proves to be a coward, leaving Hefty to prove just how brave he is when he sends the dragon away from Smurf Village.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy and Smurfette are captured by the wicked Bombast, who plans to exhibit them in his sideshow. Papa Smurf hurries to their rescue and using the bungling Gargamel for interference is able to rescue his Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Because they feel unappreciated, Poet and Painter leave Smurf Village and head for Storm Island, totally unaware that Gargamel is planning to trap them. Papa Smurf and his faithful volunteers rescue their friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: King Argon is a burly, boorish brute, but his wizard Mordain is worse still. He plans to use several Smurfs he has captured to steal all of the King's gold...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Being asked to go to the Marsh to bring back the rare Foxfire is a great honor for a Smurf. But Scaredy Smurf is reluctant to confront the Marsh Monster so he sends the Smurf who cannot say no.

programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.desc: Wrecks, Reefs, and the Secret Life of Sponges - Islamorada is a diver’s dream — but we’re going deeper than the postcard views. We explore iconic wrecks, glide over kaleidoscopic reefs, and shine a spotlight on the reef’s unsung heroes: sponges, the quiet powerhouses that keep the waters here uniquely clear. Finally, we dive into the newest breakthroughs in coral restoration that could change everything.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: Hop in the float plane—a new episode of DIRT just dropped. The DIRT crew made their way to Alaska, “the land of earth, sea, and sky.” All feast, no sleep is the name of the game as Josh makes the most of Alaska’s abundant and legendary daylight alongside local guides, fishermen, and even a couple grizzlies. There’ll be plenty of time to hibernate in winter. But for now—join us—there are halibut to filet, rainforest ’shrooms to forage, and mountainside meals to cook up.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Often misunderstood, brown bears are one of North America's most formidable predators. Taking part in a scientific collaring program to better understand predator-prey interactions, Dan Cabela travels to Kodiak Island to meet the research team.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff dive into the wild waters off Hawaii’s coast, coming face-to-face with sharks and graceful manta rays. The adrenaline peaks when Kyle takes a heart-pounding leap off a towering 40-foot cliff, making this adventure as daring as it is unforgettable.

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.desc: Danny discovers two northern Michigan watering holes and fishing with a local guide, Reel Tales Fishing Charters.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: From battling towering 12-foot waves in the Gulf of Alaska, to reeling in colossal 200 lb. halibut, they discover firsthand the rugged beauty of America's 49th state. This episode highlights Lindell Yachts as a top builder of rugged offshore sportfishing yachts, as well as Radon Boats as great pilothouse fishing and guide boats.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael and Larken travel to South Carolina's Lowcountry for a massive barbecue charity event supporting children battling serious illness. After serving up smoke for a great cause, they spend an extra day in the marsh chasing redfish and speckled trout.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Join the Mayor of Destin as he ventures into the world of coastal fishing, leaving the city behind for a day of fun and unexpected challenges. With plenty of laughs and surprising twists, this episode showcases the Mayor in a whole new light.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Despite the weather, Capt. Josh Calhoon and his wife Anna take a day off to target mangrove snapper before moving into deeper water to search for quality amberjacks.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal

programme.title: Goin' Coastal

programme.title: Goin' Coastal

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff join a local biologist searching for a white rhino whose tracking collar has failed, leaving it exposed to poachers. As they follow its trail through the African bush, the search builds toward a heart-pounding encounter that none of them will ever forget.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle takes to the water in a way few anglers dare, fishing from a Sea-Doo in search of the ancient lake sturgeon, a species that’s been around since the age of the dinosaurs and can live over 100 years. Hooking into one of North America’s largest freshwater fish from a personal watercraft proves to be a challenge unlike any other.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff embark on a 20-day mission into the Everglades to find the invasive pythons that are plaguing the ecosystem. These apex predators have eliminated more than 90% of fur-bearing animals in their new home. Can they turn the tide, or is the Everglades already lost?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff get bit by catfish in Southern Oklahoma with YouTuber Nate Williams of Adrenaline Rush Adventures while using the most primitive fishing tactic - hand fishing. Learn from the Chickasaw Nation about the history of this method that has been used by Native Americans for thousands of years.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he journeys to his final destination in Namibia in pursuit of the elusive Damara Dik-Dik. These tiny antelope—famed for their large eyes and extremely shy nature—present a unique challenge even for a seasoned hunter. Active only in the early mornings and late evenings, their limited movement leaves Mark with a very narrow window of opportunity to successfully harvest one and cap off his African adventure.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Continuing on with his quest for The North America Deer Slam, Mark Peterson packs his Gunwerks Nexus 300 PRC rifle for a hunt in Mexico targeting the elusive Mexican Texanus Whitetail from elevated blinds. The outfitter here has done an amazing job managing the deer numbers and age groups to grow giant whitetails. Mark is anticipating the pre-rut will get these big bucks moving.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson’s South African adventure continues! In this episode, he takes on the rugged terrain of the Orange Free State while pursuing four unique and challenging trophy species. Watch as Mark puts his spot-and-stalk skills to the test against the lightning-fast Kalahari Springbok and the elusive Common Reedbuck hidden in thick cover. The intensity builds as he and the crew track the striking White Blesbuck across the open plains and pursue the Tsessebe — one of the fastest antelope species in Africa.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's journey through the Eastern Cape of South Africa continues as he transitions from daytime stalks to the stealth of the night. In this episode, the focus shifts to one of the most elusive members of the "Tiny Ten"—the Cape Grysbok. Primarily nocturnal, the Cape Grysbok is a master of blending into the thick brush making it very difficult to get a good shot off. Hunting these ghosts requires a different set of skills and equipment, often involving spotlighting from the back of a Land Cruiser to catch the reflection of their eyes in the dark. Watch as Mark and the crew navigate the rugged Eastern Cape terrain under the stars, utilizing spotlights to locate their target.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he embarks on a thrilling hunt in Croatia for the Eurasian Brown Bear. Experience the beauty of the Croatian wilderness and witness the skill and precision required for a successful hunt. Follow along as Mark faces all the challenges dealing with wind and a big bear that is extremely smart, making it very difficult to harvest this amazing animal. Don’t miss this exciting hunting adventure with Mark Peterson in Croatia!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark's quest for the South America Waterfowl Slam has now taken him to Peru where he finds a surprising density of Cinnamon Teal. Although he already checked this species off the list in Argentina, his first hunt in Peru proves to be one of the best Cinnamon Teal shoots of his life. This is only the first afternoon and there are 5 days left to hunt the remaining 7 species.

programme.title: Baitfuel Fishing Tournament

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: Guadalajara’s heritage runs deep. On the DIRT crew’s latest adventure, they explored the region’s rich history from volcanic highlands to secret surf coves. Chefs Xrysw Ruelas and Óscar Segundo sent Josh and co. to load up on locally grown coffee, spearfish between catching waves, and follow freshly harvested agave on its journey to becoming tequila. After learning the ropes of Mexico’s national sport, Charreria, and hitting up a Lucha Libre match, all the local flavors came together in a feast backed by thousands of years of tradition. There really is something special in the soil here.

programme.title: Huckberry Homes
programme.desc: "In this episode of Huckberry Homes, we traveled down to Jacksonville, Florida to meet up with longtime friend, GORUCK Co-founder, and former Special Forces Green Beret Jason McCarthy. When he’s not rucking to and from the GORUCK HQ, you can find him and his friends putting on grueling garage workouts that are the talk of the neighborhood. - Huckberry and GORUCK go way back, we’ve shared plenty of good times, GORUCK Challenges, and (more than) a few beers along the way. Their military-grade lineup is designed to be taken to hell and back in the field. So whether you’re traveling the world or “embracing the suck” with a 30 LB plate in your rucksack, you can be sure your gear’s up to the challenge."

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S09
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: DESTINATION FRANCOPHONIE 2025-2026
programme.desc: The Pyramid, Vila 31, the College of Europe... Discover Tirana, the vibrant Albanian capital, in the company of Thomas Frasheri. Dive into the festive atmosphere of the Albanian Night, then enjoy an exceptional meeting with Edi Rama, the very Francophile Prime Minister. Final stop, Shkodër, the cycling capital, and its fascinating Marubi museum.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S10
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S12
programme.desc: Max Brumberg, flute designer, has set himself a challenge: that of resurrecting the aulos, an instrument that has lain forgotten for 2,000 years. Resembling a recorder, the aulos produces an enchanting, magical note. In classical times, it was said to hypnotise and bewitch the listening crowds.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: Off to Montreal to discover the Musée des Beaux-Arts. Guided by meditation, Mathias Bensimon creates profound and luminous canvases. Haider Ackermann expresses the sensuality and eroticism so dear to Tom Ford, while adding a touch of poetry and gentleness. Sculptor Salomé Cousseau shapes wood with passion and elegance.

programme.title: #VF S09
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Palais Galliera and Ulgador display their most exquisite creations with grace and sophistication. Ceramic artist Sarah-Linda Forrer and Marie-Hélène Poisson's Atelier MHP preserve and modernise exceptional know-how. Weaving and industrial design reinvented with the high-warp looms at the Font & Romani Paris workshop and with Victoria Wilmotte.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S09
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: DESTINATION FRANCOPHONIE 2025-2026
programme.desc: Welcome to Kosovo, the youngest state in Europe, perhaps the least known of the Balkans. Discover the must-see places and the cultural and gastronomic riches of Pristina, the vibrant capital, with Desantila Muriqi, a committed young Kosovar. Then visit the remains of Ulpiana, the Pompeii of the Balkans, with archaeologist Ilir Culaj.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S10
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S12
programme.desc: Feet firmly on the ground but her mind in the world of cutting-edge technology, the artist Camille Scherrer brings enchantment to everyday reality through her interactive works that add a touch of fun to their poetic beauty.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: The Maison des Canuts traces the long tradition of Lyon's gold, silver and silk weavers. Each creation by visual artist Sarah Valente sounds like a call from the forest. Zomer is turning fashion upside down. In Brittany, craftsman Thibaut Thierry works paper with seaweed.

programme.title: #VF S09
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: At the Élysée Palace, the 4th "Made in France" fair, veritable showcase for French know-how, welcomes 122 companies. All about the origins of rhinestones, and how they revolutionised the art of jewellery-making. Alençon, in Normandy, global benchmark in the exceptional craft of lacemaking. How to wear gaiters.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S09
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: DESTINATION FRANCOPHONIE 2025-2026

programme.desc: Red es detenido y apresado en una cárcel encubierta donde se enfrenta a un antiguo enemigo que amenaza con comprometer a toda la red de inteligencia de Estados Unidos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: A medida que surge el caos en la Fábrica, dejando en el aire el destino de Red (James Spader) y el comando especial, el jefe Cooper del FBI (Harry Lennix) lucha por rescatar a su equipo desde el centro de detención. Mientras tanto, se trata de una carrera contra el tiempo para impedir que Luther Braxton (estrella invitada Ron Perlman) se apropie de información confidencial.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El rescate de un agente secuestrado de la CIA hace que Liz se enfrente a un líder separatista uzbeko que conoció a Red en el pasado, a la vez que ella pasa a ser el blanco de una investigación de un asesinato en D. C.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red avisa a Liz de la desaparición de Justin Kenyon (Stephen Bogardus), un líder de un culto polígamo que tiene unos contenedores peligrosos enterrados en su propiedad, con lo que el grupo de trabajo se dispone a investigar. Red utiliza sus fuentes para descifrar las últimas palabras de Fitch y viaja en busca de su caja fuerte escondida.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red ayuda a Liz a rastrear a un escurridizo asesino en serie, mientras busca a la persona cuyo número encontró en el apartamento de San Petersburgo.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Una antigua amante envuelve a Reddington en un juego mortal con una familia rica y poderosa que obtuvo su fortuna de una subasta clandestina de contrabando de personas y mercancías. Mientras tanto, Tom se hace cargo de una nueva misión.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La investigación de un asesinato amenaza con sacar a la luz al grupo de trabajo. Red recurre al FBI para encontrar a un antiguo socio que será la clave para que Liz no ingrese en la cárcel.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: A medida que nuevas pruebas amenazan a Liz de ser procesada por asesinato, Red y Ressler se disponen a encontrar a la única persona que puede exculparla.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo identifica a una Blacklist, una artista experta en falsificaciones que ataca a la élite más adinerada. Tom le implora ayuda a Liz. Red presiona a Liz para que le dé el Fulcrum, afirmando que es una cuestión de vida o muerte.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El grupo de trabajo va en busca de una provocativa delincuente de la lista negra (la actriz invitada Ana de la Reguera), una especialista en incriminar a la élite adinerada en casos fabricados. Tom ruega a Liz que le ayude. Red presiona a Liz para que le entregue el Fulcrum, alegando que es cuestión de vida o muerte.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Con su vida pendiente de un hilo después de que le tendiesen una emboscada, Red envía a Liz a buscar a la única persona que podría averiguar los secretos que contiene el Fulcrum.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Después de que Liz (Megan Boone) es secuestrada por un hombre que dice ser su padre, Red (James Spader) se dispone a hallarla cueste lo que cueste. Mientras, la Fuerza de Tareas lucha con la noticia de que Liz está viva.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Después de decodificar la información contenida en el Fulcrum, Red se decide a detener la amenaza inminente. Mientras tanto, el equipo de trabajo descubre que se están sacando clandestinamente del país cadáveres de mujeres chinoamericanas bajo identidades falsas. Liz continúa buscando respuestas sobre su pasado después de descubrir una foto escondida en el piso secreto de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Siguiendo información de Red, el FBI está a punto de atrapar al asesino ruso más peligroso, Karakurt, que se encuentra en territorio de los EE. UU. Para evitar una catástrofe, Liz y Ressler se reúnen con la contrainteligencia rusa, que les ofrece información no solo sobre Karakurt, sino también sobre la identidad de la madre de Liz. Cooper se encuentra en una posición comprometedora.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: En el final de la temporada, Liz se da cuenta de que está siendo incriminada por el Cabal, obligando a Red a usar a sus contactos para ayudarla a limpiar su nombre. Mientras Cooper recibe noticias impactantes, Ressler Samar (Mozhan Marno) y Aram deben determinar en quién se puede confiar dentro del grupo de trabajo.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El estreno de la temporada comienza con la búsqueda que el FBI hace de Liz por el asesinato del Fiscal General. Red y Liz están en la lista de los 10 Fugitivos más buscados del FBI y se han dado a la fuga para evitar ser capturados. Red recurre a un miembro de La Lista Negra llamado “El Granjero Trol” para que lo ayude a huir de la ciudad, y la fuerza especial debe cuestionarse en quién de los suyos aún puede confiar. Lo colocan a Dembe en una situación peligrosa y comprometida.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Ressler le pisa los talones a Liz después de que ella se refugia en la embajada rusa. Solo puede confiar en Red, quien contrata a un abogado llamado Marvin Gerard para sacarlos de una situación delicada con rehenes. Mientras tanto, el FBI trata de expulsar a Cooper.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La asesora presidencial Anna McMahon se enfrenta a Cooper y al equipo en una carrera para localizar el expediente perdido que contiene detalles de una conspiración contra Estados Unidos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y Liz viajan hacia el Medio Oeste en su misión para exonerar a Liz y derrotar al Cabal. Ressler, Samar y Aram continúan en la búsqueda de los fugitivos, topándose en el proceso con lo que podría convertirse en una crisis alimentaria mundial. Mientras tanto, Cooper se convierte en un sorprendente aliado.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y Liz continúan su misión para limpiar el nombre de Liz. Red pide ayuda al grupo de trabajo para ayudarlos a encontrar a una mujer llamada Djinn, una alcahueta que cumple fantasías de venganza. Creen que Djinn podría llevarlos hasta el Cabal, lo que sería el siguiente paso para exonerar a Liz. Mientras tanto, Tom y Cooper unen fuerzas para ayudar a Liz y seguir el rastro de nuevas pistas.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Ofrecen una enorme recompensa por la agente Keen, despertando el interés de un gran número de asesinos. El FBI y Reddington unen fuerzas para protegerla.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y Liz se enteran de que Andras Halmi, un consejero confiable del Director, ha desaparecido. En la búsqueda de Halmi, Red y Liz escapan por los pelos de un enfrentamiento violento. Mientras tanto, Tom acaba en un brutal Club de la lucha para encontrar al único hombre que cree que podrá exonerar a Liz.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando Red recurre a Samar para buscar a un escurridizo secuestrador iraní, Tom presiona a un sicario del Cabal para exonerar a Liz.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: A medida que el FBI se acerca, unos delincuentes secuestran a Red, lo que obliga a Liz a dejar de huir para acudir en su busca.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Aram lucha por proteger a Liz en su cautiverio, Tom y Ressler unen fuerzas para alejar a Karakurt (el actor invitado Andrew Divoff) de las manos del Cabal.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Liz se prepara para ser llevada a juicio, Red lucha para protegerla del Cabal.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Liz observa desde la barrera, Red pone sobre aviso al grupo de trabajo sobre una reunión secreta de los jefes mundiales del crimen que ha sido convocada para vengarse por cooperar con el FBI.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras la fuerza especial investiga a un grupo paramilitar con raíces en el siglo XV que persigue a los pedófilos, Liz se enfrenta a una decisión crucial acerca de su futuro con Tom.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y Liz unen fuerzas con el grupo de trabajo para detener a un negociador que ha vuelto a aparecer para unir a dos familias criminales rivales. Tom retoma el contacto con un antiguo amor.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La reaparición de un niño que, supuestamente, había muerto dos años atrás lleva a Red y a Liz tras la pista de un siniestro personaje que parece sacado de un cuento de hadas que lleva a cabo sacrificios humanos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y el FBI buscan a un asesino en serie que publica las fotos de sus víctimas para un proyecto de arte en Internet. Liz se reúne con Tom, que está gravemente herido.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red persigue a un delincuente de la lista negra cuyos secretos amenazan con desatar una ola de ataques de venganza. Mientras planea su futuro con Tom, Liz continúa buscando la verdad sobre su madre.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Después de que Reddington descubra que unos ladrones van detrás de un arma nuclear militar, el grupo de trabajo se ve envuelto en una carrera contrarreloj para detenerlos y así evitar un inminente desastre nuclear. Mientras tanto, Tom y Liz toman una decisión que cambiará su relación para siempre.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Una tragedia ha puesto a un miembro del equipo en grave peligro, por lo que el grupo de trabajo debe confiar en Red y sus poco convencionales métodos para sobrevivir. Mientras tanto, Tom y Liz se enfrentan a una complicación inesperada que podría afectar al futuro de su bebé.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Una mujer atractiva y misteriosa que huye de unos atacantes desconocidos se cruza accidentalmente con Reddington y recurre a su ayuda para luchar contra sus atacantes.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Una pérdida inesperada ha dejado devastado al grupo de trabajo del FBI, que debe rastrear a sus atacantes: un misterioso grupo cuyos agentes operan usando una red de satélites global. Mientras tanto, Reddington se ve obligado a enfrentarse a un fantasma de su pasado que conoce muchos secretos sobre él.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Reddington vincula a una mujer poderosa y extremadamente peligrosa con la reciente tragedia. El grupo de trabajo deberá perseguirla para detenerla antes de que vuelva a atacar.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La búsqueda de venganza del grupo de trabajo del FBI se acerca a su final. A medida que Reddington y el equipo se acercan al misterioso archicriminal responsable de la reciente tragedia, se ven obligados a trabajar fuera de su zona de confort y fuera de la ley para acabar con su enemigo de una vez por todas.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando Reddington y la fuerza especial están a punto de encontrar al responsable de la muerte de Liz, una inesperada traición los obliga a apresurarse para salvar a uno de los suyos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Con su imperio criminal en ruinas, un Red sorprendentemente despreocupado recluta a Liz en un plan poco probable para ganar efectivo simultáneamente y entregar a un nuevo Blacklister al Task Force. Mientras Liz se enfrenta a la nueva realidad de trabajar junto a su padre, Ressler se encuentra en una posición precaria y Tom sopesa sus opciones.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Después de que Liz (Megan Boone) es secuestrada por un hombre que dice ser su padre, Red (James Spader) se dispone a hallarla cueste lo que cueste. Mientras, la Fuerza de Tareas lucha con la noticia de que Liz está viva.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red (James Spader) recluta a Tom y a la Fuerza de Tareas para rastrear a un famoso cazarrecompensas que podría conocer los movimientos de Alexander Kirk. Mientras, Liz (Megan Boone) se pregunta si Kirk es confiable.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red (James Spader) y la Fuerza de Tareas toman medidas extremas para cazar a Miles McGrath (Tate Ellington), un aliado de Alexander Kirk, una 'incubadora criminal' que financia crímenes para beneficio propio. Mientras, Liz (Megan Boone) aprende más sobre su familia.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Red (James Spader) envía a Liz (Megan Boone) y a la Fuerza de Tareas a perseguir a un ecoterrorista con una misteriosa conexión con Alexander Kirk, Tom (Ryan Eggold) toma cartas en el asunto.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz sigue a Red hasta Ginebra en busca de Kirk. La fuerza especial va detrás de una turbia organización que asesina inventores prometedores para que sus nuevas tecnologías no lleguen a comercializarse.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Nada es lo que parece cuando el equipo especial se enfrenta a la reaparición de un miembro de la Blacklist y a la aparente muerte de un espía. Mientras, Red intenta contrarrestar un atrevido movimiento de Liz.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando Alexander Kirk contrata a un misterioso grupo que se especializa en hackear los sistemas informáticos más seguros del mundo, Red y Liz ven una oportunidad para hacerle una propuesta a la organización de Kirk.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red le pide a la fuerza especial que vaya tras la pista de una persona que proporciona nuevas identidades a criminales en fuga. Mientras tanto, a medida que la salud de Alexander Kirk se va deteriorando, Liz recurre a Cooper para que la guíe en una decisión crucial.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La fuga de Kirk del hospital lleva a Red a ofrecerle una cura para su enfermedad hematológica terminal a cambio de la libertad de Liz.

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Hoy en Shark Tank México: Una pareja de diseñadores con un producto funcional y agradable a la vista (CREW RACKS); un emprendedor con un negocio helado, para rejuvenecer billeteras (SUBZERO); dos inventores con un sistema de seguridad para hogares (SAFETY ORNAMENTAL); y dos ingenieros oaxaqueños con una empresa que busca revolucionar la industria de los alimentos (INALIM).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Hoy en Shark Tank México: Un negocio que huele muy bien, y que además protege el medio ambiente (KEPLER); un padre y su hijo que quieren ganarse un lugar en el negocio del beisbol en México (RHINO BATS); tres hermanos con una empresa con 90 años de tradición en México, que quiere conquistar el mundo (RASPADOS JALISCO); y dos madres de familia con una práctica solución para un problema de todos los días (TUBBIES).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Hoy en Shark Tank México: dos jóvenes emprendedores, con un producto para protegerse de las inclemencias del clima (RAINCARD); tres ingenieros con una solución tecnológica a un importante problema de salud (THERMY); un equipo de socios con la meta de revolucionar las ventas en el transporte privado (KRGADOS); y un pitch sorpresa, venido directamente de la temporada 1 del programa (THE SECRET DONUT SOCIETY).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Hoy en Shark Tank México: Una pareja que quiere deslizar su negocio en el tanque (EVANO), Un joven que saber darle valor a cosas que otros ya no quieren (NOVADIAM), Un joven emprendedor que ha roto los estereotipos de su contexto (CABALUSSA) y un emprendedor regio que trae un proyecto muy innovador (LIMOMIX).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Hoy en Shark Tank México: dos hermanos con un proyecto hecho a partir de una curiosa materia prima (BAMBOO LIFE); un “biker” con una aplicación que podría salvar miles de vidas en todo México (RADAR BIKER); una pareja que se toma la belleza muy en serio (RV EYELASHES); y un inventor con un producto moderno e indestructible (LIFT VR).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Hoy en Shark Tank México: Un sistema de organización que permite a cualquier persona cumplir sus metas (LIFE PLANNER); una plataforma en línea que cambiará la forma en que reparamos nuestros autos (GARAGE); dos regiomontanos que inventaron la boleada perfecta (SUBARAYA); y tres hermanos con un producto pensado para mejorar la integración de los más pequeños de la casa (TEDDY CHAIR).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Hoy en Shark Tank Mexico: Un bar inspirado en la lucha libre y con un giro muy diferente (EL RING BAR DE CEREAL); una emprendedora con un invento que cambiará la forma en que las mujeres se despintan las uñas (XO KYUT); dos hermanos con una plataforma de realidad virtual para evitar accidentes de trabajo (PICOSO GAMES); y una empresa familiar que busca una inversión para llegar a todo el mundo (FRUNATURAL).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Hoy en Shark Tank Mexico: Un negocio que une la gastronomía y la artesanía (KOEN), un producto mexicano para deportistas (HOLIX LAB) y un dulce negocio con enfoque social (HAPPY MARMALADES).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Primer episodio de Shark Tank México cuarta temporada: un proyecto que cree en las segundas oportunidades (MEXICANA JAIL BRAND), además un proyecto que reinventa una comida tradicional (ROSSONERO FOODS), también una app que sorprenderá a los tiburones (MATCHDOG) y por último un emprendimiento que cuestionará la moral de nuestros inversionistas (HOMEWORK DEALER).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Segundo episodio de Shark Tank México, cuarta temporada: una marca de productos para la playa, que busca el aval de un socio tiburón (BLUE SEAL); does emprendedores con un producto tradicional que quieren llevar al mercado masivo (KEFIREE 10); un negocio que se que se encarga du cuidar los "tesoros" de los padres de familia (NIÑERAS.COM.MX) y un invento 100% mexicano, que quizá sea demasiado bueno para ser cierto (JEROL).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Tercer episodio de Shark Tank México, inicia con un equipo leonense con las botas bien puestas (ULÄN), después un emprendimiento verde que busca ayudar al planeta mejorando nuestros hábitos (VIEN), posteriormente un proyecto canino con una muy particular oferta (BLEIZ) y para cerrar una doctora que convirtió su pasatiempo en un gran negocio (CONSERVANDO RECUERDOS).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Cuarto episodio de Shark Tank México una pareja con un negocio integral (AYNI), un joven que está orgullosamente en el programa favorito de su papá (INK INC), un proyecto de movilidad muy divertido (PORAY) y un invento que podría cambiar la cocina japonesa (SUSHERO MACHINE).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: En el quinto episodio de Shark Tank México: Un emprendedor que se siente “muy salsa” (Casa Maregal); un par de socios con un producto que “envolverá” a los tiburones (Wrapis); dos hermanos que traen un negocio sobre ruedas (Bifi); y dos jóvenes mexicanas que embellecerán el tanque con arte y moda (Pai Pai).

programme.title: Shark Tank México
programme.desc: Hoy en Shark Tank Mexico: Un bar inspirado en la lucha libre y con un giro muy diferente (EL RING BAR DE CEREAL); una emprendedora con un invento que cambiará la forma en que las mujeres se despintan las uñas (XO KYUT); dos hermanos con una plataforma de realidad virtual para evitar accidentes de trabajo (PICOSO GAMES); y una empresa familiar que busca una inversión para llegar a todo el mundo (FRUNATURAL).

programme.title: Shark Tank México

programme.title: Shark Tank México

programme.title: Rescate Al Amanecer
programme.desc: En 1965, un piloto germano-estadounidense que participaba en una misión de bombardeo de alto secreto fue derribado sobre Laos y llevado a un infernal campo de prisioneros en lo más profundo de la impenetrable selva de Vietnam

programme.title: Abismo
programme.desc: Gail Berke y David Sanders están pasando unas idílicas vacaciones en las Bermudas. Mientras practican submarinismo, de repente, se topan con los restos del naufragio de un buque de carga de la segunda Guerra Mundial, en cuyo interior hallan miles de ampollas de morfina. Este descubrimiento los lleva a ponerse en contacto con un traficante haitiano y un buscador de tesoros

programme.title: Soy Espia
programme.desc: La superestrella Eddie Murphy (The Nutty Professor) se une a Owen Wilson (Zoolander, Behind Enemy Lines) en un emocionante viaje cargado de acción. Famke Janssen (X-Men, GoldenEye) también aparece como una agente secreta supersexy. Un poderoso avión espía experimental es robado por un malvado traficante de armas y está a punto de ser vendido a un grupo terrorista internacional. El gobierno de los Estados Unidos prepara a un boxeador egocéntrico (Murphy) para que se una al sofisticado agente especial (Wilson) en una peligrosa misión secreta para recuperar el avión. Armado con los últimos artilugios tecnológicos y mucho carácter, esta extraña pareja podría ser capaz de salvar el mundo, si se pudiesen llevar bien.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: Una nave espacial que viaja a un planeta-colonia lejano y transporta a miles de personas, tiene una avería en una de sus cámaras de sueño. Como resultado, un único pasajero se despierta 90 años antes de tiempo. Ante la perspectiva de envejecer y morir solo, finalmente decide despertar a un segundo pasajero.

programme.title: Krull
programme.desc: En esta aventura fantástica, ambientada en un mundo poblado por criaturas mitológicas y mágicas, el planeta Krull es atacado por un monstruo y un ejército de alienígenas asesinos. Para hacerles frente, dos naciones enemigas deciden unir sus fuerzas por medio del matrimonio del príncipe Colwyn (Kaen Marshall) y la princesa Lyssa (Lysette Anthony); pero el día de la boda, el palacio es asaltado, la princesa secuestrada y Colwyn herido. El príncipe deberá entonces encontrar el Glaive, un arma mágica, para rescatar a la princesa y salvar el planeta.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Un monstruo gigante, originado mediante grandes radiaciones, aterroriza a la isla de Manhattan, sembrando el pánico entre sus habitantes. La criatura destruye todo lo que encuentra a su paso.

programme.title: Cazafantasmas (2016)
programme.desc: Nueva versión de una de las películas más emblemáticas de los años ochenta: Los cazafantasmas. Después de casi treinta años, los fantasmas y demonios se han vuelto a escapar de los infiernos para destruir Manhattan. Ahora, el equipo de los Cazafantasmas está formado por un grupo de mujeres dispuestas a terminar con todas las amenazas paranormales.

programme.title: The Mask Of Zorro
programme.desc: Cuando un déspota sediento de poder planea comprarle California a México, hacen falta dos Zorros - el legendario Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) y su sucesor elegido Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas), un gallardo bandido convertido en héroe - para frustrar los planes sin escrúpulos del tirano. ¿Pero bastará la combinación de sus habilidades, sus bravuconerías y proezas para lograr el objetivo final de De la Vega: vengarse del hombre que mató a su mujer, secuestró a su hija y lo tuvo prisionero durante veinte años?

programme.title: La Leyenda Del Zorro
programme.desc: ¡El justiciero de la capa original ha regresado! Antonio Banderas y la ganadora del Oscar(r) Catherine Zeta-Jones (2002, mejor actriz de reparto, Chicago) vuelven con más duelos a espada, aventuras y emoción en el explosivo espectáculo cinematográfico, ¡THE LEGEND OF ZORRO! Tras pasar los últimos diez años luchando contra la injusticia y la crueldad, Alejandro de la Vega (Banderas) se enfrenta ahora a su mayor desafío: ¡su amada esposa Elena (Zeta-Jones) lo ha echado de casa! Elena ha pedido el divorcio y ha encontrado cobijo en los brazos del conde Armand (Rufus Sewell), un apuesto aristócrata francés. Pero Alejandro sabe algo que ella no sabe: Armand es el maligno cerebro de una trama terrorista para destruir Estados Unidos. Así, con su matrimonio y el futuro del país en juego, el Zorro debe salvar dos uniones antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Sicario: El Día del Soldado
programme.desc: La guerra contra el narcotráfico se intensifica cuando la frontera entre Estados Unidos y México se vuelve aún más brutal.

programme.title: Mandíbulas
programme.desc: Bienvenido al Lago Negro. Este tranquilo paraje es el último lugar en el que uno esperaría encontrar un reptil de 9 metros de la especie Crocodylus, más conocida como cocodrilo. Es en este lago donde una paleontóloga neoyorquina con fobia a la naturaleza, que ha sido enviada a regañadientes para su primera misión de campo real, se une a un excéntrico multimillonario para encontrar esta amenaza.

programme.title: Christine
programme.desc: La retorcida historia de amor de un adolescente y su celoso Plymouth Fury modelo 58.

programme.title: Kung Fu Sion
programme.desc: La historia se sitúa durante el caos pre-revolucionario de los años 40 en China. Sing (Stephen Chow) es un delincuente con poca suerte decidido a entrar en el Axe Gang, uno de los clanes mafiosos más importantes de China. Para lograrlo, Sing pretende sacar dinero de los vecinos de un bloque de casas, pero pronto descubre que éstos no son lo que parecen. La banda Axe Gang acude a la zona y una serie de sucesos lleva hasta la confrontación final entre los vecinos y los delincuentes.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Un grupo de documentalistas se traslada a la selva amazónica para localizar a la tribu indígena de los Shirishama. Este grupo está formado por una directora de cine, Terri Flores (Jennifer Lopez), un antropólogo, Steve Cale (Eric Stoltz), un encargado de sonido, Gary Dixon (Owen Wilson), un cámara, Danny Rich (Ice Cube), un narrador, Warren Westridge (Jonathan Hyde) y una productora, Denise Kahlberg (Kari Wuhrer). A ellos se les une Paul Sarone (Jon Voight), un misterioso ex-sacerdote convertido en cazador, que asegura saber dónde se encuentran los Shirishama, por lo que se convierte en su guía. Pero, en realidad, a donde les dirige es a la caza de un reptil único en el mundo: una inmensa serpiente anaconda de doce metros de largo.

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: Un aterrizaje de emergencia deja tirados a Kitai Raige (Jaden Smith) y a su legendario padre Cypher (Will Smith) en la Tierra, 1000 años después de que el cataclismo obligara a la humanidad a escapar de ahí.

programme.title: Gloria (1999)
programme.desc: Gloria ha pasado tres años en la cárcel por culpa de su novio mafioso, Kevin. Nada más salir, se salta la libertad condicional y vuelve a Nueva York con su banda. Al llegar, se encuentra con que Kevin y los suyos han secuestrado a un niño después de matar a sus padres.

programme.title: Invasión A La Tierra
programme.desc: Durante muchos años ha habido casos documentados sobre testigos que han visto OVNIS en todo el mundo.Pero lo que hasta ese momento eran simples avistamientos, en 2011 se convierte en una terrible realidad cuando la Tierra es atacada por fuerzas desconocidas.Una tras otra van cayendo las grandes ciudades del mundo, y Los Ángeles se ha convertido en el último bastión de la humanidad. Un sargento de la Marina (Aaron Eckhart) y sus hombres tendrán que enfrentarse en una inesperada batalla a un enemigo absolutamente desconocido.

programme.desc: Alice regresa a The Hive en Raccoon City, donde Umbrella Corp está reuniendo fuerzas antes del ataque final a los últimos.

programme.title: La Venganza De Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: La película está basada en la historia real del legendario sheriff, y en ella Earp cuenta cómo reunió a los mejores hombres del Oeste para vengar el cruel asesinato de su querida Dora. Acompañado por los famosos Bat Masterson, Charlie Bassett, Bill Tilgham y Doc Holliday, Earp persigue a los hermanos Kenedy, que han iniciado una matanza que se extiende desde Dodge City a México. Los despiadados hermanos saben que la ley no puede tocarlos, porque les protege su poderoso padre, pero subestiman a Earp y a sus compañeros. Con Shawn Roberts, Matt Dallas, el cantante country nominado a los Grammy® Trace Adkins y Val Kilmer.

programme.title: La Habitación Del Pánico
programme.desc: Una madre y su hija van a vivir a su piso recién comprado, en la primera noche descubren que unos asaltantes han entrado en su casa, su única salvación será la habitación del pánico construida para estos casos.

programme.title: Xxx 2: Estado De Emergencia
programme.desc: En esta secuela atiborrada de acción del éxito de taquilla xXx, Ice Cube interpreta a Darius Stone, un liante en busca de subidones cuyos antecedentes policiales y su obsesión por los deportes extremos le convierten en candidato ideal para ser el próximo agente xXx. Debe salvar a Estados Unidos de una conspiración letal del general de cinco estrellas y Secretario de Defensa George Deckert (interpretado por Willem Dafoe). Solo un renegado agente xXx como Stone tiene las habilidades extremas para evitar que el peligroso grupo disidente del ejército tome el gobierno en la capital de Estados Unidos.

programme.title: El 6º Día
programme.desc: El piloto de helicóptero Adam Gibson, después de una jornada aparentemente normal regresa a casa y se encuentra que ha sido suplantado por un clon. Cuando los creadores de su réplica descubren que no ha muerto en accidente, como habían previsto, intentan darle caza.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: Esta aventura de acción sobrenatural está basada en la aplaudida saga de Mike Mignola para Dark Horse Comics. Llevado a la Tierra por el malvado genio Rasputín (Karel Roden) para ayudar a los nazis en su causa moribunda, Hellboy (Ron Perlman) fue rescatado por el profesor Broom (John Hurt), fundador de la organización clandestina O.D.I.P. (Oficina de Defensa e Investigación Paranormal), que lo crió y desarrolló sus extraordinarias dotes paranormales. A pesar de sus oscuros orígenes, Hellboy se convierte en un inesperado paladín del bien, luchando contra las fuerzas malignas que amenazan nuestro mundo junto a un "hombre pez" telépata (Doug Jones) y una "piroquinética" (Selma Blair). Ocultos ante la sociedad a la que deben proteger, son la clave de la defensa contra Rasputín, que pretende recuperar a Hellboy para el lado oscuro y usar sus poderes para propiciar el Armagedón.
