programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma’s in a dilemma: handsome Byron has invited her to his birthday party on his uncle’s yacht. Her girlfriends tell her it’s no place for someone who transforms into a mermaid at the slightest drop of water. But Emma willfully goes along. Afraid she’ll do something silly, her girlfriends and Lewis join the party.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: A grand holiday resort on Mako Island? Its idyllic slopes covered with concrete and the volcanic lake inside the mountain, where the mermaids first transformed, converted into a swimming pool? Only Zane’s father could have dreamed up such a development. But Emma, Cleo and Rikki aren’t going to let this happen!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma loses her mermaid nature and her powers after touching some mysterious blue seaweed. Remembering what it’s like being “normal” - she used to be a passionate swimmer - she rejoins the synchronized swimming team, which is preparing a show for the Summer Solstice Festival.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: More and more plastic bags are polluting Dolphin City Bay, and the turtles mistake the bags for sea-sponges and suffocate on them. Our three mermaids, alerted by their friend Teddy the turtle, tackle the problem. After some unsuccessful attempts, they and Lewis decide to use stronger methods to stir up public opinion.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a violent storm, Dolphin City looks like a new Bermuda Triangle: boats mysteriously break down or sink in the bay. At the sight of hordes of journalists, the girls investigate, with Lewis’ help. They find out that a lightning bolt from the storm has activated mysterious crystals whose magnetic field disrupts navigation equipment.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: When Emma, Cleo and Rikki find out two superstars – Brad Patinson and Scarlett Belladonna - are shooting a film in Dolphin City, directed by the famous Martin Fabiola, they try anything to get on the set. Luckily Zane has been hired by the production! Only Rikki prefers to approach the stars in her own way – underwater of course!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Murray and Burke are inconsolable: their pal Danny the octopus has disappeared! By chance, Cleo finds out that he’s in fact been captured by the Oceanic Center, who are conducting scientific research. Murray puts pressure on the mermaids to get Danny out of there and bring him back to the sea. But Danny doesn’t want to go home.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Why has a whale calf run aground on an isolated beach near Dolphin City? And what’s causing the girls’ migraines? Does it have anything to do with the dolphin twins’ bizarre sickness? During their investigations the mermaids come across a strange fishing boat using illegal technology: an extremely low-frequency military radar device.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Burke the hammerhead shark has broken a tooth. To sooth the pain, he has to come up for air at the surface regularly: but in so doing, he involuntarily shows his fin. Before long a panic wave runs through the citizens of Dolphin City, who think they’ve got a dangerous shark on their hands.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Rikki has to make up for her mistakes! Convinced that her father’s new girlfriend, Cathy, is dishonest, Rikki sabotages the dinner in which her father tried to ask Cathy for her hand in marriage. To bring the estranged sweethearts back together, Rikki absolutely has to recover the lost engagement ring, which fell into the sea during that tumultuous dinner.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Worrying events agitate the little underwater community of the Bay: clownfish are inexplicably disappearing one after another. The mermaids try to get to the bottom of this mystery, to find their friend Ziggy, a little clownfish who’s among those missing.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Cleo is down in the dumps: she might lose her job at the Oceanic Center, since she said she’s allergic to water, to avoid getting wet in front of Mr. Lambert. Swimming out at sea, she wanders into a strange stone circle – suddenly she wishes she could forget all about this mermaid business. Her wish comes true.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Valentines Day! Lewis and Abby spend the day together like sweethearts. Cleo goes crazy with jealousy. She finds out that Lewis has promised to tell Abby a huge secret. And what if – blinded by love – Lewis were to betray Cleo and her friends, by revealing that they are mermaids?! Emma, Cleo and Rikki have to get to the bottom of this

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the Bay are overwhelmed: one of the dolphin twins, Robby, has disappeared, captured by an unknown speedboat. Bernie calls on our three mermaids for help: the girls were walking around Dolphin City, which is all decked out for the carnival. But why would anyone kidnap a dolphin?

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Assumming their and Manjipoor's world are literally on different frequencies, JB tries super-amplifiers. Kuru and weakened Alex indeed return to the kingdom, where the people is in doubt who to obey. Alas after they shred the abdication papers Diva puts up a devious fight.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: At home, JB and Amanda try to convince the Wilson parents missing Alex will be back. With help from the people, brave Kuru cunningly frees Alex, Omar and Vashan, who shows them a rune to restore one's powers, but it can only be used with magic.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Smash is looking forward to 4 paid hours in a recording studio. Anala, who has been a jumbo-size pain for a while, takes Alex's guitar and transports her, first with and then without Kuru, to places she believed to exist only in a childhood dream. There she learns the elephant always protected her.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Alex is too sad about Marcus having dumped her and effectively split up the band Smash to do her school - or domestic work. Even ever-respectful Kuru can't deny she lacks commitment, especially as the princess. She now declares herself ready to accept the throne.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Having learned Omar is her dad, Alex has ran back to the Wilsons. Kuru comes pack, take his leave from the Wilsons and offer generous gifts. They include a model and wood for a Manjipoorean gazebo, which dad Jim is unable to construct, but he gets JB to help and talks him into making up with Alex.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Just when Vashan prepares for his coronation, he discovers Diva has magical powers, but too late: she throws him in the dungeon. When Omar and while he flees Kuru find out, she tries to kill them, but Anala saves them by transportation to the Wilson home. Alex uses magic to cure Omar's wound.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Assumming their and Manjipoor's world are literally on different frequencies, JB tries super-amplifiers. Kuru and weakened Alex indeed return to the kingdom, where the people is in doubt who to obey. Alas after they shred the abdication papers Diva puts up a devious fight.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Tara risks serious injury and possible expulsion to compete in the Prix de Fonteyn Preliminary Round, and Kat is on top of the world when she’s allowed back into the Academy.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Whilst recovering from her broken back, Tara discovers a hidden side to Ben who is volunteering in a hospital leukaemia ward performance; and Kat tries to settle into First Year.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: As Tara negotiates her return to the Academy, Ethan’s search for ongoing employment leads him to accept a position choreographing a fringe musical.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Sammy and Ollie’s friendship heads into unchartered territory when they go on a road trip so that Sammy can compete in a Prix de Fonteyn regional round, while Christian joins them to reconnect with his estranged father, Raf.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: The escalating conflict between the First and Second Years results in a showdown to determine which year has the greatest talent, and Tara becomes unhinged when Grace tempts her to get less serious.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: During an excursion to the circus, Christian’s dad makes promises he’s unable to keep, Tara tries to repair her friendship with Kat and Sammy goes public about his new romance.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Tara hunts for a new crush while the director of a fringe musical tries to convince Abigail to be the star of his show and Grace goes to increasing lengths to get Zach’s attention.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru reports diplomatically to Omar about Alex's slow progress and Devi to Vashan that she's still a magically clumsy brat living a commoner's life, the rival prince allows her to return as butterfly and seduce Kuru as Juliet, so he'll cease being her only good influence.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru accidentally breaks JD's cymbal, but pays for it with a golden coin from Manjipoor worth the eightfold, which he spends on flashy clothes. The Wilsons see Kuru gets rewarded too. When Alex flippantly calls his allowance excessive, he dutifully begs the council to reduce it, which is nearly considered treason for questioning one of its decisions.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: A remark at mother's day from her sanctimonious sister Zoe that Alex is adopted makes her wonder about her magical biological mother, queen Nefari. After Kuru says Omar knew her best, she travels to Manjipoor alone to question him. Vashan spies on them and magically set a trap, entering the queen's magical posthumous vision.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru warns Alex the powerful royal rune to shift time back in order to change things has only been used twelve times for extreme emergencies. Reasoning one wouldn't know if the royal user doesn't tell, the scamp keeps abusing it for petty accidents all day when Marcus finally asks her on a real date.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru tells Alex that Anala's birthday is a grand state affair in Manjipoor, where the elephant chooses one subject to be granted a wish. She offers to his and Omar's delight to preside over the palace party. Told it's invitation only, she magically fakes invitations for her friends and even a few Manjipoor commoner market acquaintances.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Marcus got the band a gig in his uncle Harry's café, where Zom Records executives have lunch, but the stage is too small, so they must perform a duet by Marcus and Alex, who abuses some minor magic. Omar informs the elders one of Anala's magical headdress jewel was stolen.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: The band bunch prepares for the school's masked dance, an concept unknown to Kuru. JB was turned down by 48 girls, so he's desperate to ask Kosma on the Manjipoor market and tricks Alex to take him there, supposedly looking for her perfect dress, behind Kuru's back.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru reports to Omar and the council of elders about Vashan's hostile intrusion in the other world, but they can't counter a royal. Meanwhile Vashan has used the magical gem again, and using a box and carpet can prevent being sent back.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Marcus and Alex want to exchange one month together-gifts. Alex just asks Kuru's wise advice, but Marcus left the choice to Amanda. Kuru generously gives her one the royal Manjipoor coins she admires. Amanda tricks sweet-tooth Anala into transporting her to Manjipoor to buy a diamond necklace.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Sparks fly when some ancient Wolfblood relics are discovered and Tom finds a kindred spirit in Kay.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Lost without her pack, it's a full moon and Jana's inner wolf has become morwal - a bitter angry wolf with the instinct to attack.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Rhydian is determined to help Jana while Shannon follows her dream and Tom faces the wrath of the K’s.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Rhydian and Jana mysteriously collapse as a comet appears on the dark of the moon – can Shannon save the day?

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Jana, Tom and Shannon go to Segolia where Tom discovers something mysterious and terrifying that changes his life.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Tom is out of control so Rhydian, Shannon and Jana turn to Segolia for help.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Emma, Rikki and Cleo are teenage girls with a secret - they’re still mermaids. They’re handling life pretty well but the threat of the full moon, and the strange effects it has on mermaids, looms. This time Lewis is certain he can help but things go awry and the girls are moonstruck.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Cleo uses her mermaid powers to avoid a sprinkler and inadvertently splashes Charlotte, the new girl at school. Lewis and Charlotte meet and it’s clear she likes him straight away. With the girls’ mermaid powers turned up to max, Lewis tries his best to help but his attempts only cause Cleo to feel crowded by him.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Zane’s back in town and still in love with Rikki. Although he believes she’s not a mermaid anymore, things are still tense between them. Rikki assures Emma she can handle Zane; they broke up and that’s all there is to it. As Zane continues to try to win Rikki’s affections, he realises she’s still a mermaid and saves her from the threat of discovery.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit by messing up the order of things. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Meanwhile Lewis wants to know why Cleo broke up with him; concerned that he’s not masculine enough for her.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Cleo notes that Don seems to be down since her mother left. Later, Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls, supposed to grant wishes. Cleo instantly thinks it could help get Don and her Mum back together. They make the potion and it doesn’t seem to work.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Life isn’t the same at Cleo’s house since her mother left. When it appears that Don has a girlfriend - Cleo and Kim are horrified, thinking this means a step-mother. Meanwhile, Charlotte is making more moves on Lewis, making Cleo increasingly jealous. Don organises a dinner and Cleo is shocked to find her Dad’s new partner is Charlotte’s mother!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: To help their friend Cleo get hired (as a volunteer) at the Dolphin City Oceanic Centre, Rikki, Emma and Lewis take her out free-diving off Mako Island, to see underwater wildlife in person! But when their motorboat’s engine fails, they have to spend the night on the island: that night, when Rikki, Emma and Cleo are exploring the island, they fall into a mysterious cave.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Little Elliot gets his big sister Emma to enter the Grand Sand Sculpture contest with him. Meanwhile Cleo’s day starts badly at the Oceanic Center: Mr. Lambert puts her in charge of the new intern - Miriam, the Mayor’s daughter and high school pest! Miriam lives up to her reputation, and submits Cleo to a series of capricious outbursts.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: During a scientific experiment conducted by Lewis out at sea, the three mermaids find a wooden statue of a white mermaid on the seafloor! Lewis discovers it’s the figurehead of a famous pirate galleon, the White Mermaid, which sank at sea without a trace! Rikki and Emma are thrilled, while Cleo is preoccupied by something else.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma’s in a dilemma: handsome Byron has invited her to his birthday party on his uncle’s yacht. Her girlfriends tell her it’s no place for someone who transforms into a mermaid at the slightest drop of water. But Emma willfully goes along. Afraid she’ll do something silly, her girlfriends and Lewis join the party.

programme.desc: The time of destiny is now! Yugi vs. Atem!

programme.desc: Atem has summoned all three Egyptian Gods!

programme.desc: Not only does Atem still have all three Egyptian God Cards, Yugi doesn’t have a single monster on the field!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and Atem – more than friends, closer than brothers.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: When the #1 ranked duelist and ruthless tycoon, Seto Kaiba, kidnaps Yugi’s Grandpa to get the rare Blue-Eyes White Dragon card, Yugi must face Kaiba in the ultimate Duel Monsters showdown!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi is forced to face Duel Monsters creator, Maximillion Pegasus, in the mysterious Shadow Realm where all the monsters and magic are real. If Yugi loses, Pegasus claims Grandpa’s soul as his prize!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi gives up one of his own Star Chips so Joey can board the boat bound for Duelist Kingdom and duel to save his sister’s eyesight. Meanwhile, the cheat Weevil tries to cripple Yugi’s deck by tossing his best cards overboard!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pegasus announces that there are many strange secrets that will make his ultimate tournament unlike any they’ve ever had. Yugi must not only figure the rules out, but master them if he’s to survive!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After Yugi defeats Weevil’s first wave of Duel Monsters, Weevil has one last trick up his sleeve; a ravenous Great Moth that grows in power every turn! Can Yugi find a way to destroy this winged beast before it destroys him?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey finds himself courageously accepting a challenge from veteran duelist, Mai. But when Mai begins to demonstrate an unnerving psychic ability, Joey has to figure out Mai’s secret strategy before falling victim to it!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey finds himself courageously accepting a challenge from veteran duelist, Mai. But when Mai begins to demonstrate an unnerving psychic ability, Joey has to figure out Mai’s secret strategy before falling victim to it!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The fisherman duelist baits Yugi into a duel on his own sea playing field for a home-field advantage. Can Yugi adapt to these new settings to turn the tide of battle?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: If Yugi is eliminated from the tournament, KaibaCorp’s crooked Board of Directors will transfer control of the company from Kaiba to Pegasus! Kaiba’s brother Mokuba challenges Yugi to a duel to protect his brother’s company!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi must duel a magical doppelganger of Kaiba. But with his best cards resting at the bottom of the ocean, Yugi must discover a new strategy to survive fake Kaiba’s powerful Blue-Eyes White Dragon!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi defeats Blue-Eyes White Dragon, but there are two more waiting in the wings! Will the real Kaiba reach Yugi in time to help beat this impersonator?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey decides to battle Rex Raptor without his friends’ help to prove that he is man enough to take care of Serenity on his own. But as Rex Raptor’s relentless dinos destroys Joey’s best Duel Monsters, will Tristan’s card remind him that with his friends, he is never alone in battle?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey duels valiantly, but Rex Raptor has unleashed his secret weapon: Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Joey must figure out the secret of Yugi’s gift, the Time Wizard card, without Yugi’s help or he’s taking the next boat out of Duelist Kingdom!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi’s classmate Bakura, possessed by his Millennium Ring’s dark powers, traps Yugi and friends in a Shadow Game where they become the cards themselves! Not only must Yugi battle to avoid becoming a permanent part of the card game, but also free Bakura’s soul from the Millennium Ring’s control!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pegasus’s hired duelist PaniK cheats Mai of all her Star Chips, and Yugi vows to defeat him and win them back. But when PaniK’s Castle of Dark Illusions enshrouds his monsters in a black mist, how can Yugi defeat an enemy he cannot see?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despite his astonishing disadvantage, Yugi boldly provokes PaniK: “I’ll finish you in three turns.” Is Yugi bluffing, or does he have the advantage in this battle of wits?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba descends to the kingdom to face Pegasus! Has Kaiba changed since his battle with Yugi, or is he still the same merciless duelist? A battle between Kaiba’s Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon holds the answers!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The #1 American duelist Bandit Keith’s gang kidnaps Joey to a secret cave with a graveyard playing field. As Yugi and friends search for him, Joey faces Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters which become stronger as they return from the grave! Joey is all alone in the battle this time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey’s last ditch effort, his lucky Time Wizard card, fails against Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters. But as his lucky streak comes to an end, will his improving skills as a duelist and his love for his sister inspire him to victory?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Trapped in the labyrinth cave, Yugi and friends find an alternate exit, but the door is guarded by Pegasus’s Paradox Brothers. Yugi and Joey will no longer be battling solo; they band together in a team battle against the Paradox Brothers! The battle for all the Star Chips and entrance to Pegasus’s castle is on the line!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey pool their strengths and manage to fend off their opponents’ monsters, but things are about to change as the Paradox Brothers summon the almighty Gate Guardian, a monster that reflects all attacks! Is Joey helping Yugi in this duel, or his lack of experience sealing their fate for defeat?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey each unleash their strongest monster, Summoned Skull and Red-Eyes B. Dragon, but their strength pales in comparison to the tremendous power of Gate Guardian. Individually, our heroes have no chance, but they will unleash the greatest power of all: teamwork!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Using the magic of the Millennium Eye, Pegasus traps Mokuba’s soul inside a card right before Kaiba’s eyes! In order to earn the right to challenge Pegasus, Kaiba must first beat Yugi and take his Star Chips. The rematch between Yugi and Kaiba is about to begin!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba summons Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the strongest monster in the game fused from three Blue-Eyes White Dragons! Yugi has lost all his powerful Duel Monsters, but a true duelist never gives up!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi begins spinning a strategy to put Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon to rest, but he must decide whether to claim victory or spare Kaiba his life. Yugi’s heart is split in two!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Having lost his Star Chips to Kaiba and his only opportunity to save Grandpa, Yugi is in a state of shock. Can Téa bring Yugi back to consciousness by defeating Mai for her extra Star Chips and teach Yugi the heart of the duelist?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends enter the castle to discover Kaiba ready to duel Pegasus with Mokuba’s soul hanging in the balance! The power of the Millennium Eye gives Pegasus the ability to read other people’s minds. Can Kaiba defeat an opponent who knows his moves even before he does?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba is helpless against Pegasus’s Toon World deck and mind-reading abilities. As the duel ends, Pegasus imprisons Kaiba’s soul into a card, just like Grandpa and Mokuba! Yugi has had enough!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: T’was the night before the final battle, and many creatures are stirring! Yugi vows to overthrow Pegasus for the sake of his Grandpa. Tristan leads an exploration party to uncover Pegasus’s secrets. While Joey sleeps, Bandit Keith steals from him the card that permits his entry in the final battle!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Under Pegasus’s weighty glare, Yugi is distracted from his duel with Mai. After making foolish tactical errors and allowing Mai to gain a huge advantage with her Harpie's Pet Dragon, will Yugi gather his focus or succumb to the intense pressure?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mai has rebounded from her previous loss to Joey to become a better duelist. Has Yugi learned from his loss to Kaiba, or is the emotional defeat still weighing on his heart? The answer is in the cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey frantically searches for the card that permits him to enter the final battle, not realizing Bandit Keith has stolen it from him. As he struggles to accept the fact that Serenity will be blind forever, he receives help from a new, and unexpected, friend!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After Bandit Keith’s Machine deck forces Joey to take the defensive, Joey mimics Keith’s battle strategy to metalicize his Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Is victory assured, or does the cheater Bandit Keith literally have one last card up his sleeve?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With his pride in his strength as a duelist on the line, Joey challenges Yugi for the right to face Pegasus. In a battle between friends, a fierce match ensues between the two people who know each other’s strategies and cards as they struggle to keep their thoughts of past loyalties at the back of their minds.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi is shocked as Joey uses the Time Wizard card on him, the very card he gave Joey as a sign of friendship! However, as the two battle each other valiantly and one comes out the victor, they find confirmation of the strength of their friendship that surpasses any duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi prepares for the ultimate battle against Pegasus with the souls of Grandpa, Kaiba and Mokuba on the line. Meanwhile, Tristan and Bakura infiltrate the castle to find the Kaiba brothers, but at this crucial moment, is Bakura turning back into his evil self again?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi’s monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi’s soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: To gain eligibility to join the Junior Youth Championship, Yuya has to win 4 official duels consecutively. He ends up dueling is Michio Mokota, a cuisine Duelist with high popularity among the housewives.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya faces a ferocious attack against Michio Mokota's Cooking Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: It's a case of mistaken identity when Yuya is eyed as the primary suspect for attacking Leo students! But when Yuya crosses paths with the real culprit, things go from bad to worse!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya matches minds with the quiz whiz extraordinaire Pierre L'Supérieure in a duel of wits! Can Yuya outsmart the smartest boy on Earth, or will Yuya end up scratching his head in defeat?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: In the finale of the mind-bending match that's part-duel, part-quiz show - one wrong answer could mean curtains for Yuya! Can he outduel and outthink a trivia whiz who's never wrong?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: It's a Duel against Jurou's former disciple, Yamikawa! Yamikawa draws his Ninja monsters, pinning Yuma down, but believing in the power of his friends, Yuma must continue this battle to the Death! But, Yamikawa summons his Trump Card, the Number Monster "Armed Ninja - Crimson Shadow"! However, Yuma continues to believe in the power of his friends, but can this possibly lead him to win the Duel!?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Kotori and her friends, who are interested in the Number cards, plus Astral, form the "Number Club". To get more info about the Numbers, they visit the home of a fortuneteller, but the fortuneteller is under the orders of Kaito to collect the Number Cards! When the fortuneteller, Jin, kidnaps Kotori and the rest, Yuma and Astral come to the rescue, but the memory of their Duel with Kaito comes back, the visions of which continue to haunt them!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: To save Kotori and the rest, Yuma continues to fight with Jin over the Numbers. Yuma's Life Points continue to fall, putting the fate of Kotori and the rest in a perilous situation, as Jin worsens things by summoning a second Numbers. In the midst of such a terrible pinch, Astral finds himself scared by Kaito's looming shadow, but when he sees Yuma who refuses to give up, he steps back up to the fight. With the feelings of these two guys, "Utopia" obtains a new power!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma misplaces the the Emperor's Key that was an important momento from his parents. He and Astral look high and low for it, but they just can't seem to find it. While they look, Astral is curious as to how the Emperor's Key is related to Yuma's father. Yuma starts talking about various memories from his childhood that he remembers about his dad. Yuma's Never-Give-Up Spirit "Kattobingu" was born from a promise he made with his father.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma safely recovers "Number 96: Black Mist" from a man. Tetsuo, who witnessed the Duel, takes note that Yuma seems suddenly more brutal in his strategy, and ends up in a fight with him. Not having reconciled in over 2 days, suddenly Number 96 swallows Yuma and Astral up!! To rescue Yuma and Astral from Number 96, Tetsuo fights the Numbers for the first time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi has found a counter to Pegasus’s mind-reading ability: Yugi switches back and forth between his two souls! Yugi is able to destroy Pegasus’s Toon World, but the duel has just only begun. The next level of the deadly Shadow Game is about to start!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi crumples in exhaustion under the crippling power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi’s chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pegasus summons Relinquished, a fearsome monster that can consume Yugi’s Duel Monsters! Yugi counters with… Kuriboh? The smallest, weakest creature in the game? Has Yugi given up, or does he have one last strategy to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? The Shadow Game comes to a close!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The Pegasus Saga comes to an end, but a new journey is about to begin! Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi’s mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her! She’s here to claim back the card that Grandpa stole from her grandfather many years ago!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca mistakenly believes that Grandpa stole Blue-Eyes White Dragon from her grandfather. Yugi must defend Blue-Eyes White Dragon to teach her that it’s not the power of the cards, but the heart that’s in them that counts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The two-faced Board of Directors of KaibaCorp trap Kaiba inside a virtual reality game! Mokuba recruits Yugi and Joey to free Kaiba from this ultimate game where losing equals death!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The quest for Kaiba continues with a little help from… Mai? But can Yugi and friends adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way?

programme.title: Mahler Song Cycles: Songs on the Death of Children

programme.desc: A cerebral explosion of technical wizardry and complex structures. Dive into a fusion of dizzying riffs, odd time signatures, and soaring melodies as masters of their craft redefine metal's limits in this experimental sound lab.

programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: The Art of Destruction
programme.desc: Der Produzent Ilija Jelusic hat jahrelang die Band „Destruction“ begleitet.

programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programme.desc: In Abercorn, the natural pond has progressed nicely and new trees have been planted on the property. At Montréal Plaza, we gain a better understanding of how Charles-Antoine's creative spirit comes to life in the kitchen and through his connection with local producers.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Cauliflower and broccoli, differently. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet prepares orecchiette with broccoli pesto and a cauliflower tabbouleh. Discovery of the day: recycled Glask glasses, or how to create beautiful glasses from discarded bottles.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: For those who want to get ahead on weekly meals, Isabelle shares a special spaghetti sauce recipe, perfect for freezing.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Rencontre avec Nicolas Bucher, éleveur de vache montbéliarde, et avec Nathalie Vernerey, cheffe de culture maraîchère aux Jardins d'idées. Le phytomanagement au Living Lab de Vieux-Charmont, avec Michel Chalot, professeur d'université et biologiste en environnement. « Pas si bêtes », avec Thibaut Seguin, animateur à La Damassine."

programme.title: SAUVE MA RECETTE
programme.desc: Using salt instead of sugar in a cake mix is a mistake that can happen to the best of us. Chloée, Chef Oli and Christian show us clever, anti-waste recipes to save our baking and our taste buds!

programme.title: TRES TRES BONNE LECON (LA)
programme.desc: How to open an oyster? Steak tartar: should you use a mincer or a knife? Approved by leading professionals, François-Régis Gaudry offers some seriously good tips for foodies.

programme.title: La Recette de Guy Martin S08
programme.desc: Le chef étoilé Guy Martin présente les produits emblématiques du terroir français et propose une recette pour les accommoder.

programme.desc: An immersion in Campania, between tradition, authentic flavors and exceptional gastronomy. Together with Alfonso Iaccarino, meeting Tonino Santa Rosa, a local fisherman, Giovanni and Giuseppe, artisan ice cream makers. A stage that ends in the Michelin-starred restaurant Don Alfonso 1890, around a dish of scorpion fish pasta.

programme.title: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programme.desc: Charles-Antoine's father comes for a visit with a very special gift. This year, the Montréal Plaza staff party takes place in Abercorn. It is an opportunity to move forward with the tyre foundations for the garage.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Mushrooms and eggs. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet prepares baked eggs with mushrooms and a spring frittata (Italian egg-based dish), with lots of greens (dandelion, arugula, spinach). Discovery of the day: artisanal mate, a drink that is all the rage.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: To entertain simply and stylishly, the chef offers a menu featuring haddock poached in coconut milk and a crunchy salad.

programme.desc: Vincent Labergère est producteur de Sauternes ; Émilie et Michel Dudon sont éleveurs de volailles en plein air. En compagnie d'Adrien Billotte et Pierre Cante, tout savoir sur le bombage et la cartographie, pour lutter contre la flavescence dorée.

programme.title: SAUVE MA RECETTE
programme.desc: What can you do if you have been too heavy-handed with the spices? Don't panic, the team is there to try to rise to the challenge and save your dish.

programme.desc: For the first time, Charles-Antoine chairs a pie contest in Abercorn, with a special guest. Before that, he installs reclaimed planters and receives the beehives from his friend Anicet.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: April Fools fish. Accompanied by Brigitte Rosset, Annick Jeanmairet prepares a fish ceviche with leche de tigre, a more complex mixture than lime juice, followed by fish paupiettes wrapped in chard leaves, steamed. Discovery of the day: chard táchon.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: Ricardo joins Isabelle to celebrate bread in all its forms: a savory garlic version, perfect for sharing, and a brioche variation with chocolate, cranberries, and ginger.

Sortie nature dans les marais, avec la guide nature Caroline Géneau. Découverte du cap Blanc-Nez, avec Martha Coquet, animatrice d'Eden62.

programme.title: TRES TRES BONNE LECON (LA)
programme.desc: How to open an oyster? Steak tartar: should you use a mincer or a knife? Approved by leading professionals, François-Régis Gaudry offers some seriously good tips for foodies.

programme.desc: Itinéraire gourmand à travers les territoires, à la découverte de leurs spécialités et des artisans qui perpétuent leurs traditions culinaires. L'occasion de faire une halte dans la cuisine d'un chef de talent pour préparer une recette régionale emblématique.

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: Isabelle prend un raccourci en utilisant des sauces trouvées dans le commerce pour une recette de riz frit et une salade de nouilles de riz au chou.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "La brigade de l'Académie partage sa passion du jardinage avec les usagers du potager de La Récolte des générations. Dany, Véronique et Bryan rencontrent une famille au jardin communautaire et découvrent l'organisme UNIATOX."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo

programme.desc: À chaque épisode, un voyage ! Xavier Petit, caméraman reporter, nous fait découvrir un pays, une ville, un peuple et, bien sûr, un marché traditionnel et une spécialité locale.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03

programme.title: Ton plat mon plat

programme.desc: "Édith et les élèves de l'Académie découvrent le rôle des oiseaux au potager et plantent des pommiers. La famille Claveau-Audet visite la ferme Les Jardins Lakou et cuisine avec des légumes antillais fraîchement cueillis."

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se muestra perturbada ante la irrupción de Wilker en sus pensamientos ante el reproche de Yubiri Juan Diego se decide a acomodar lo acontecido con su frustrado compromiso para su beneficio al recordarle a Yubiri que cayo preso debido a su estadía en el barrio | Yubiri se deja halagar por la justificación de Juan Diego al retomar nuevamente su idea de haber sido la causa que permitió que el muchacho no se comprometiese | Juan Diego se aprovecha de la situación.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Luis Fernando llega a su casa y María Gracia le da la sorpresa de que Dileidy lo fue a buscar a su casa y Aureliano le dice a Dileidy lo mismo. María Gracia está por irse de modelo a Japón y antes de irse, le dice a Luis Fernando que busque a Dileidy.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska seduce a Ricardo, provocando el llanto de Manuela. En la junta, Benjamín Malaver intenta destituir a Ricardo, pero Manuela lo respalda y frustra el plan. María del Pilar es agredida y miente para protegerse. Celia invita a Moisés y su abuela a vivir con ella, enfrentando la oposición de Benjamín. Margot investiga la identidad real de Malaver. Finalmente, Manuela planea vender sus acciones para una clínica, mientras Katiuska vuelve a manipular a un confundido Ricardo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Dos mujeres campesinas rescatan a Rosa del encierro pero la abandonan en la montaña. Alejandro y José Luis son auxiliados por una grúa. Erasto es encontrado inconsciente y robado por campesinos. Rosa lo encuentra al borde del precipicio y arriesga su propia vida para salvarlo, sin saber que es el asesino de Carlos y el secuestrador. Erasto se arrepiente del atentado contra su vida. Marisela acepta el divorcio de Adolfo y aboga por Isaías en su empresa. Consuelo niega volver con Isaías. Natalia confiesa a René que está embarazada de Erasto y pide ayuda para abortar.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebecca se enfrenta a Agustina cuando esta la descubre con Edgar y le ofrece dinero, a Leonardo y a sus hijos a cambio de su silencio. Leonardo regaña a Julio por lo que hizo. Él le dice que se siente excluido de la familia y para remediarlo, Leonardo le ofrece trabajar en la empresa, siempre y cuando se disculpe con su hermano y le cuente la verdad a María Lucía. Virginia va a visitar a Carlos Ernesto y se reconcilian. Él le pide que vuelva a ser su secretaria. Jimena se reúne con Adolfo y le dice que no se casará con él, porque la prioridad son sus hijos. Jimena, después de la reunión con Adolfo, va a casa de Carlos Ernesto y le comunica su decisión, pero con la condición de que él vaya a la clínica a rehabilitarse.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro trata de acercarse a Sol y tener contacto amoroso, pero ella se resiste, dando por sentado que son hermanos. Es por esto que le pide a Aída que vuelva a vivir a la casa, para acercarse a Alejandro y ganar su amor. Aída sabe que esto no es cierto, sin embargo, Heriberto la llama, ya que si ella se queda con Alejandro, Sol buscará consuelo en él, entonces la amenaza, y si ella no cumple con eso, él buscará la manera de herir a Alejandro o a los niños.
